 Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying that in the
circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith, the High Court may be
pleased tobe pleased to issue a writ, Order or direction more particularly one
in the nature of Writ Of Mandamus declaring the highhanded action of the
Respondents No. 5 to 9 releasing the land acquisition award amount without
considering my objections representations dated 15.06.2018, 19.05.2023 and
30.05.2023 by taking bribe Rs.10 lakh from the Respondent no 10 to 12
whose land entered in the disputed register/prohibited land record in respect
of land admeasuring an extent of Ac.3.30 Cents in Sy.No.879/1, and Ac 1.0
cents in Sy.No.879/5 of Bommaiahgaripalli Revenue Village, Rompicherla

Learned counsel for petitioner sought permission of this Court for withdrawal of the writ petition.
Learned counsel endorsed the same on bundle.
Permission is accorded.
Accordingly, the Writ Petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
There shall be no order as to costs.

As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
